title: Complex Divide HDL Optimized
text: Divide one input by another using CORDIC algorithm and generate optimized HDL code, 3 inputs, 3 outputs, {Output datatype} sets Data type of output; {Show divide by zero port} sets the whether to show the divideByZero port, {Automatically select CORDIC maximum shift value based on input word length}, {CORDIC maximum shift value} sets the maximum shift value of hyperbolic vectoring CORDIC and {Number of iterations per pipeline register} sets the number of CORDIC iterations to perform per pipeline. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: validIn
ports.summary: Whether input is valid Boolean scalar

ports.name: y
ports.summary: Output computed by dividing inputs complex scalar

ports.name: divideByZero
ports.summary: Whether the value at output is the result of division by zero Boolean scalar

ports.name: validOut
ports.summary: Whether output data is valid Boolean scalar

params.name: Output datatype
params.values: Data type of output fixdt(1,18,10) (default) | single | double | fixdt(1,16,0) |

params.name: Show divide by zero port
params.values: Whether to show the divideByZero port off (default) | on

params.name: Automatically select CORDIC maximum shift value based on input word length
params.values: Automatically select CORDIC maximum shift value based on input word length on (default) | off

params.name: CORDIC maximum shift value
params.values: Maximum shift value of hyperbolic vectoring CORDIC wl - 1 (default) | 10 | positive integer-valued scalar

params.name: Number of iterations per pipeline register
params.values: Number of CORDIC iterations to perform per pipeline stage 1 (default) | positive integer-valued scalar
